snippet.title: The Crust 1.0 – Teaser Trailer | Lunar Base Building & Automation
snippet.description:
The Crust reaches version 1.0 on September 10, 2026. Watch the official announcement teaser for the lunar base-building and automation strategy game.

Play The Crust on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1465470/The_Crust/

Build and automate a lunar colony above and below the Moon’s surface. Mine resources, create production networks with conveyor belts and drones, manage your colonists, explore the Moon, trade with Earth, and help determine humanity’s future.

THE CRUST 1.0 WILL INCLUDE:

• A full story campaign with multiple endings
• Planning Mode and Sandbox 2.0
• Expanded colony and automation systems
• Global disasters and new strategic challenges
• Visual improvements and a major optimization pass
• More tools for building and managing your lunar operation

The Moon is ready. Are you?
#TheCrust #BaseBuilding #AutomationGames
